justification: Restores two production cron workers (dcp-extract 03:00 UTC, dcp-commit 09:00 UTC) that crash at start-up on every run, and the commit job's page-link repair, which exited before its write. Not Critical: no code path or query changes, only which files ship in the image, and the failure was loud (ImportError, Railway status Crashed), never wrong data served. Not Minor: it decides whether DCP extraction and commit run at all, and it widens a guard test.

pre_impl.existing_data: none -- no table, column or query is touched. The image gains 10 script files and data/chapter_scope/ (3 JSON files, 276K), all already on main.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The existing guard test claimed every worker import was copied. It was blind to `from scripts import X as y`: the module name sits after `import`, and the scan reduced the line to the root package `scripts`, which it skips. Once that was fixed the scan also reached gate_rules_roads/areas (module-level in gate_rules) and the dcp_page_repair -> dq_probe_live / outreach_claim_checks chain. A second blind spot remained that no import regex can close: dq_probe_live reads data/chapter_scope/*.json at module level, a FileNotFoundError.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Applies to the next image Railway builds from main; no backfill. Every run since #1285 was a no-op crash, so changed chapters queued in that window are picked up on the next dcp-extract run by its own change detection.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a module any DCP worker reaches is not COPYd, or a file a worker opens at import is not COPYd, or the `from scripts import X` form is dropped from the scan again
falsifiable_check.observed_red: YES, forced twice. Removing the dcp_area_link_guard COPY fails test_every_local_module_a_worker_reaches_is_copied. Removing the data/chapter_scope COPY fails test_each_worker_imports_from_the_image_file_set[dq_probe_live]. Both restored green (14 passed). The origin/main COPY set, imported the same way, reproduces Railway's exact error: "ImportError: cannot import name 'dcp_area_link_guard' from 'scripts' (unknown location)".

functions.name: _imports
functions.input: the full source text of one worker or sibling script
functions.output: top-level module names it imports, now including each X in `from scripts import X as y`

functions.name: test_each_worker_imports_from_the_image_file_set
functions.input: the COPY lines of Dockerfile.monitors, replayed into tmp_path
functions.output: pass when `import <worker>` succeeds in a subprocess against only those files
functions.if_none: a ModuleNotFoundError for a non-local, non-repo package skips (CI may lack a third-party wheel); any other failure, including a missing local module or data file, fails

values.if_missing: section_reader runs only with DCP_READER=section; Railway dcp-extract variables were listed (names only) and it is not set. conveyancing_db is imported only inside outreach_claim_checks functions dcp_page_repair never calls. If DCP_READER=section is ever set on Railway the worker raises ImportError loudly, it does not degrade.

break_it.scenario: A future module-level import in a worker is added without a COPY
break_it.what_happens: worker crashes at start-up on every cron run; Railway shows Crashed
break_it.how: the closure scan and the file-set import test both fail in CI before merge
break_it.repro: delete a COPY line from Dockerfile.monitors and run the falsifiable_check command

break_it.scenario: A worker opens a data file at import that is not copied
break_it.what_happens: the worker stops with FileNotFoundError at start-up on every run
break_it.how: test_each_worker_imports_from_the_image_file_set imports from only the copied files
break_it.repro: delete the data/chapter_scope COPY and run the falsifiable_check command

break_it.scenario: r2_monitor or dcp_watchdog gains a missing dependency
break_it.what_happens: they need R2/DB credentials at import, so the file-set import test cannot cover them
break_it.how: covered by the source-text closure scan only, as before

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes -- after Railway rebuilds dcp-extract and dcp-commit from main, the next 03:00 / 09:00 UTC runs should log past the import (`railway logs -s dcp-extract`) and status should leave Crashed.
